question: Why do the paper's self-retrieving agents score 0.81-0.89 on patient_diagnosis while our /env harness gave Qwen3-30B 0.466?
patients: Fixed 120 dev patients (data/splits/patient_diagnosis.json); public split untouched.

arms.paper: Upstream eval/agents structured harness, unmodified (runner.run_agent_session); open_chart.active_problems and view_problem_list return the reference diagnoses with ICD-10 codes.
arms.masked: Identical, except those two tool results pass through env_service.replace_problem_list (after the harness's own outcome-section strip), i.e. exactly what /env returns.
arms.env: Our Verifiers /env harness (training/environment), same model and sampling controls.

controls: Paper adapter defaults for all arms: temperature 0, max_tokens 16384, 40-action budget; official score_submission per episode; failures stay in the denominator at 0.

models.qwen3-30b: qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-instruct-2507 (our reference model; /env gave 0.466 at temperature 0.7)
models.mistral-3: mistralai/mistral-large-2512, the paper's registry entry (paper self-retrieving agent: 0.810 on 100 public patients)
models.llama-4: Not run: OpenRouter has no tool-capable endpoint for meta-llama/llama-4-scout (DeepInfra/Novita lack tools; Google is BYOK-only).

mistral_contrast_scope: Only the 54 patients submitted in both Mistral arms: OpenRouter 429 rate limits aborted many Mistral sessions, so Mistral mean rewards over all 120 are not interpretable.

batch_metric_skips_failures.finding: eval.scoring.compute_all_metrics skips predictions with no active/chronic entries (n_tier_c) instead of scoring them 0, although paper section 5.3 says failed sessions are scored as zero.
batch_metric_skips_failures.evidence: mistral-3/paper: 44 of 120 sessions unsubmitted; batch F1 over all 120 = batch F1 over the 76 submitted = 0.7846 (n_scored 76, n_tier_c 44).

paper_runner_scoring_note: runner.run_agent_evaluation scores raw ground truth without the chart-neutral context; paper_runner_batch_f1 reproduces that, batch_f1_with_neutral_context attaches it as score_one does.
cost_note: OpenRouter key daily usage at completion: $4.45; includes small pilots by two interrupted sessions the same evening.
